mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 38 degrees and clear near Badger Ridge Middle School under a Full Moon. You can catch the International Space Station passing over Verona High School starting at 6:38 PM, heading toward the Madison area for one minute. The overnight low will be 31 degrees with no rain predicted.

In city news, please note that all city buildings will be closed on November 26 and 27 for the Thanksgiving holiday. As a result, refuse and recycling collection will be delayed until Friday, November 27, and the recycling center will be closed those two days.

There is plenty to do, with live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness or join various trivia nights around town this coming Tuesday.
In our weekly police report, on November 4, a two-vehicle crash in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue resulted in an arrest for O W I.
Today is the perfect day to stop by for an OREO Cookie Overload, as the store is open until 10 PM tonight.
